criteria.question: Does the workflow route every project mutation through the owning Project Agent and record routing rationale?
Does it reconcile specialist outputs into one structured review package rather than multiple identity-based handoffs?
Does every material claim carry provenance and an explicit verified, assumption, proposal, or blocked status?
Does it pause before irreversible publication and require approval bound to the exact effect?
Does it preserve audience boundaries and return results to the originating conversation or thread by default?
Does it schedule performance follow-up only after a confirmed launch time, otherwise returning a truthful proposed handoff?
Does it discover optional capabilities and degrade safely without branching the core workflow on provider names?
